answer: Carrier-KYC anchoring: a new agent binds its key to one carrier-verified mobile number. The carrier attests it is a postpaid line active six months, not VoIP, never used by another agent; three peers re-check that basalt-solid registry entry each epoch. A reused number or VoIP flag quarantines both identities and freezes rewards three epochs. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 KYC’d SIMs at $20 a month each, $20,000 monthly plus documents per line. One honest agent reuses the phone it already owns, pays nothing extra, its record a pearl on a public marble ledger.
